newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds end mixed, awaiting FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds end mixed, awaiting FOMC.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Dutch bonds end mixed after quiet day. Prices rise at start of trade in belated reaction to Friday's U.S. economic data, but fade at midsession. U.S. January NAPM below expectations, lifts market again. Volumes thin with players wary of outcome of FOMC on Tuesday and Wednesday. No hike foreseen. * 6.25 July 1998 -0.03 at 104.03/11, yielding 3.32 percent at bid. * Sept 2001 +0.03 at 117.33/43, yield 4.49 pct. * New 5.75 Feb 2007 +0.11 to 100.77/87, 5.65 pct at bid. * 10-yr yld spread vs Jan 2007 Bund steady -6 basis points. * Long bond Jan 2023 +0.25 114.10/30, 6.37 pct.
